subject: Compact MAP + week0 experiment plan
content:
--- Message 1/4 ---
From: Sam Li <sam.li@novacorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact MAP + week0 experiment plan

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We have a tight window to validate Redwood for a specific workflow — 2 APIs, sub-200ms p95, and an embedding-based retrieval proof-of-concept. Can you share a short MAP / one-pager we can take into an internal kickoff?

Goal is to run a small week0 experiment with clear success criteria and a decision gate by Day 7. Stakeholders: product (me), infra (Allen Cortez), and security (TBD).

If you have a lean MAP template and a sample week0 checklist/slides, that would be perfect. We can take a 30-min sync tomorrow to align.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Li
Senior PM, Platform Integrations
Novacorp

--- Message 2/4 ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Li <sam.li@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compact MAP + week0 experiment plan

Sam — great to hear, excited to move quickly. Attaching a compact MAP one-pager and a tiny slide pack for a week0 experiment. I put a very short checklist in slide 2 that maps to acceptance gates. Links/attachments below:

Attachments: MAP_Accelerator_OnePager.gdoc (Google Doc stub), week0-experiment-slides.pptx (slide stub)
Drive links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbCdEgMAP, https://drive.google.com/file/d/0Bweek0slides

Key bits from the MAP (TL;DR):
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for retrieval-augmented generation + embeddings for search over internal KB.
- Success criteria (sample):
  - Technical: p95 latency < 200ms for 0-256 tokens on dev env; embedding cos-sim improvement > 12% vs baseline on benchmark set of 150 queries.
  - Business: demo to director-level stakeholders and greenlight to proceed to pilot with 3 internal teams.
- Week0 activities (proposed):
  1) Kickoff + access & roles (day 0) — confirm credentials, region, and security checkbox owner.
  2) Tech spike (day 1–3) — run generator + embed pipelines on a small sample, measure latency and token-cost per call.
  3) Quality check (day 4) — evaluate embeddings and generated outputs against a 50-item prompt set.
  4) Demo + decision gate (day 6–7) — present to stakeholders with raw metrics.

Suggested meeting: 30 minutes tomorrow at 11:00 PT to walk the one-pager and align owners. If that doesn't work, propose 14:00.

Questions for you before the sync:
- Who will own security sign-off for the week0 artifact? (Allen?)
- Do you have a preferred region for testing (us-west/us-east/eu)?
- Any constraints on sample data (PII, redaction?) that we should bake into the plan?

I'll be on the call; Marissa is copied and will help run the workshop and capture the MAP into a shared gdoc.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

I also copied a minimal runbook snippet into the doc so your infra team can review networking and region choices quickly. If Allen can confirm preferred test region and whether a sample data redaction pipeline is required, we'll update the MAP before the workshop.

Link to MAP gdoc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbCdEgMAP

- Allen: confirm region + redaction requirement (reply to this thread)

- Karthik / Marissa / Jasmine: we'll finalize the MAP during the sync and deliver a PDF one-pager + slide pack by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
